# El Salvador Cultural Association of Edmonton (ESCA)

> ESCA is a societal organization based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, incorporated on October 31, 2024. It's dedicated to preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of El Salvador and keeping the next generation connected to their Salvadoran roots through educational programs, cultural activities and community support. The site is available in English and Spanish.

- Founder and President: Alicia Dimas
- Location: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada
- Email: esca@escaedmonton.ca
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/esca_edmonton
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61567303020814
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/el-salvador-cultural-association-of-edmonton-esca/
